title: A current lead who is not a technician shows as "Current · no longer assignable"
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new staff member for this test, staff member B, on the built-in Technician role, with Time Clock on and Technician on, enrolled at the test location only, so the list has a technician to compare with.
  • Have a new staff member for this test, staff member A, on the built-in Parts Manager role, with Time Clock on and Technician on, enrolled at the test location only.
  • Have a new service work order for this test, work order 1, at the test location, in Approved, led by staff member A, with staff member A's Technician then switched off (and the warning saved), so the lead is no longer a technician.
  • Start on Work Orders, Board View, at the test location.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1's card more-actions menu.
  2. Click Reassign lead technician.
  3. Click staff member A's entry.
  4. Type staff member A's first name in the window's search.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The more-actions menu opens.

Step 2:

  • The Reassign lead technician window opens.
  • Staff member A is listed last, labeled "Current · no longer assignable".
  • Staff member B is offered above.

Step 3:

  • Nothing is picked: staff member A cannot be picked, and the window stays open.

Step 4:

  • The search finds staff member A's entry, still labeled "Current · no longer assignable".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Technician Toggle", Confluence 977371146, version 17 (2 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 2 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11788, story SV-11881 (Story 3, Who appears on the technician lists)

  • S3-R4: “The Assign lead technician and Reassign lead technician window (from a card's more-actions menu on Board View or Tech View) offers only people per S3-R1. Searching for anyone else shows the existing No technicians match “[search]” message. A current lead who is not offered per S3-R1 is listed last, cannot be picked, and is labeled "Current · no longer assignable"; searching for their name finds that entry.”
  • S3-R7: “A work order's current lead who is not offered per S3-R1 still shows as the lead on the work order and in Board View and Tech View. In the Lead Technician dropdown they are listed last, grayed out, with the check mark, and cannot be picked. Picking someone else saves at once, as today, and the former lead then leaves the dropdown.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Technician Toggle" (https://claude.ai/artifact/1fuPz8Y4xTg7Syq1mfmJ9R), version 1793629882-06f7, read 2 Nov 2026: page "5 Board View and Tech View", picture "Reassign lead technician, searching "Oli"" (This build)

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • tt-p5-08-after-reassign-lead-technician-searching-oli.png

The design's own words:

  • “No match: "No technicians match "Oli"". Only staff whose Technician toggle is on and whose Time Clock is on are offered.”

The "Current · no longer assignable" entry is described in the PRD and not drawn (register TT-N08).
